english: Let $A=\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ and $B=\{1,2,3\}$. For an onto function $f:A\to B$, the number of functions $g:B\to A$ such that $f(g(b))=b$ for every $b\in B$ is denoted by $N(f)$. Then the arithmetic mean of $N(f)$ over all onto functions $f:A\to B$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $A=\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ तथा $B=\{1,2,3\}$ है। किसी आच्छादक फलन $f:A\to B$ के लिए, उन फलनों $g:B\to A$ की संख्या, जिनके लिए प्रत्येक $b\in B$ के लिए $f(g(b))=b$ है, $N(f)$ द्वारा निरूपित की जाती है। तब सभी आच्छादक फलनों $f:A\to B$ पर $N(f)$ का समान्तर माध्य ______ है।
solution: $f(g(b))=b\Leftrightarrow g(b)\in f^{-1}(b)$, so $N(f)=|f^{-1}(1)|\cdot|f^{-1}(2)|\cdot|f^{-1}(3)|$; such $g$ is one-one (disjoint fibres)
Onto $f$: $3^{5}-3\cdot2^{5}+3=150$; fibre sizes $(3,1,1)$ in some order: $3\cdot\binom{5}{3}\cdot2=60$, product 3
solution_full: For a fixed onto $f$, the condition $f(g(b))=b$ means $g(b)$ is an element of the fibre $f^{-1}(b)$, chosen independently for $b=1,2,3$. Hence $N(f)=|f^{-1}(1)|\,|f^{-1}(2)|\,|f^{-1}(3)|$. The fibres are disjoint, so every such $g$ is one-one (and it can never be onto, since $|B|<|A|$).
The fibre sizes are positive and add to 5, so they are $3,1,1$ or $2,2,1$ in some order.
Sizes $3,1,1$: choose the value with 3 preimages (3 ways), its preimages ($\binom{5}{3}=10$), then the other two elements go to the other two values ($2!$): $60$ functions, each with $N(f)=3$.

Sizes $2,2,1$: choose the value with 1 preimage (3 ways) and that preimage (5 ways), then split the other 4 elements between the remaining two values ($\binom{4}{2}=6$): $90$ functions, each with $N(f)=4$. (Check: $60+90=150$.)
originality_note: New: averaging the number of right inverses g of an onto f over all onto f, which equals the product of fibre sizes; the count of onto functions and of one-one sections are combined through the fibre patterns (way 5). Closest known: number of onto functions from a 5-set to a 3-set (150) and of one-one functions from a 3-set to a 5-set (60). Different because: the quantity is a product of fibre sizes averaged over fibre patterns.
blueprint_concepts: Number of onto (surjective) functions via inclusion-exclusion
Number of one-one and onto functions between finite sets

concept_use.Number of onto (surjective) functions vi: The 150 onto functions are counted by inclusion-exclusion and split by fibre pattern (3,1,1) or (2,2,1).
concept_use.Number of one-one and onto functions bet: Each g with f(g(b)) = b is a one-one function from B to A (disjoint fibres), and N(f) counts these one-one sections; no such g is onto.
